description.value: The type of knowledge asset this library contains.

definition.value: The library contains computable logic, typically in a formal representation such as a CQL library or Java package. The content may also be made available in multiple representations, such as the source and compiled representations (CQL and ELM, or Java source and Java bytecode).
The library contains the machine-readable definition of an information model, typically in the form of a CQL Model Info or FHIR StructureDefinition resources.
The library is a collection of knowledge artifacts, each of which is identified with a composed-of relatedArtifact entry. The components of the collection may or may not be managed together.

The library is a description of the dependencies, parameters, and data requirements for a particular module or evaluation context. This type of library is used to represent the result of a data requirements operation, for example.
